Labeling rule (FILTER.md section 0, quoted): a posting is relevant when all of these hold, and not_relevant otherwise:
  - Job family: machine learning engineering, AI engineering, applied science, data science, LLM engineering, or applied ML research.
  - Seniority: entry level through mid level. Intern, Staff, Senior Staff, Principal, Director, Lead, Head and management roles are not relevant. A Senior role is relevant only when the stated minimum experience requirement is five years or less.
  - Location: Boston, New York or NYC, Seattle, or a remote position that explicitly allows working from the United States.
  - Title versus text: the actual responsibilities and minimum qualifications take priority over the title. A suitable title does not rescue a posting whose minimum required experience is more than five years (the same line as rule E01).
  - When I am unsure, the label is not_relevant.

Title: ML Engineer Manager, AI Conversation Platform
Text:
Engineering Manager, AI Conversation Platform Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. You have experience leading teams that develop streaming feature pipelines, build ML models, and deploy them to production, even if it involves making substantial changes to backend code. You are comfortable with ambiguity, love to take initiative, and have a bias towards action. Minimum requirements Have at least 4 years of experience managing ML teams Experience working as a Machine Learning Engineer, Applied Scientist or equivalent Individual Contributor.
